title: Result of contact.protect
description: Request args: {"key": 64 hex digits, "protected": true or false}. Sets or clears the native favourite flag, which keeps the contact out of the oldest-first eviction. The flag is generic to the device; a user's favourites stay in the Backend. A key that is not stored is failed with error not-found. Companion only.

type.description: Never none: type 0 is the anonymous slot's and is not a stored contact.

fav.description: The native favourite flag: the contact is protected from the oldest-first eviction.

last_advert.description: Their clock at their last advert.

hops.description: Hops of the known path; -1: none, the contact is reached by flood.

changed.description: False when the flag already had the requested value.
